name: Cyber Strike 2088
description: A fast-paced neon cyberpunk shooter where reflexes and tactical dashing determine survival across dystopian futuristic arenas.
longDescription: Immerse yourself into a vibrant neon cityscape of 2088. Battle through rogue AI drones, upgrade cybernetic enhancements, and master dynamic combo abilities in high-intensity arena battles.

name: Speed Rush: Apex
description: High-octane street racing with customizable hypercars, nitro boosts, and hyper-realistic physics.
longDescription: Burn rubber across scenic mountain passes, neon city streets, and desert highways. Customize your engine, tune drift handling, and climb global leaderboards against real players.

name: Mystic Runes & Gems
description: A mind-bending match-3 puzzle adventure featuring ancient spells, cascading combos, and tactical relics.
longDescription: Unlock ancient mysteries by aligning enchanted elemental stones. Solve over 500 handcrafted levels, trigger room-clearing elemental cascades, and collect rare artifacts to save the enchanted realm.

name: Shadow Realm Odyssey
description: An epic dark-fantasy action RPG with branching narrative choices, deep skill trees, and legendary loot.
longDescription: Step into the shoes of a fallen guardian wandering a fractured realm. Forge powerful elemental weapons, tame mythical beasts, and decide the fate of ancient kingdoms in an open-world fantasy experience.

name: Pixel Dungeon Heroes
description: Charming retro roguelike arcade crawler with procedural dungeons, pixel art, and quirky boss battles.
longDescription: Explore randomly generated dungeon floors filled with traps, hidden treasure chests, and hilarious monster encounters. Every run offers unique power-up combinations and endless replayability.

name: Slam Dunk Rivals
description: Arcade-style 3v3 street basketball with gravity-defying dunks, flashy crossovers, and hype commentary.
longDescription: Take your streetball squad to legendary urban courts across the globe. Pull off ankle-breaker dribbles, team alley-oops, and game-winning buzzer beaters in intense, rapid-fire matches.

name: Lost Horizon: Expeditions
description: Narrative-rich survival adventure across uncharted archipelago islands filled with wildlife and lost ruins.
longDescription: Stranded in an uncharted archipelago, discover remnants of an ancient civilization. Craft survival tools, chart forgotten caves, sail between islands, and unravel secrets left behind centuries ago.

name: Gravity Vortex
description: Physics-based spatial puzzler where you manipulate planetary gravity fields to guide energy orbs.
longDescription: Rotate cosmic gravitational wells and redirect laser beams to energize planetary cores. Features soothing ambient synth soundtracks and over 120 meditative physics challenges.

name: Valkyrie Drift 3D
description: Futuristic anti-gravity hover-car racing with supersonic tracks, loop-the-loops, and weapon pickups.
longDescription: Fly at Mach 2 speeds over magnetic tracks hovering above cloud cities. Use EMP blasts, energy shields, and nitro pads to edge out opponents in this thrilling anti-gravity racer.

name: Chrono Blade: Reborn
description: Stylish hack-and-slash brawler with time-slowing parry mechanics and cinematic blade finishers.
longDescription: Rewind time, freeze incoming projectiles, and slice through mechanized legions with precision swordplay. Perfect for fans of tight combat mechanics and stylish anime action.
